```{python}
#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path
import json
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.io as pio
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots

pio.templates.default = "plotly_dark"

ROOT = Path("..")
if not (ROOT / "bench-results").exists():
    ROOT = Path(".")

SHALLOW_LAYERS = 12
SHALLOW_EXPERTS = 16
FULL_LAYERS = 93
FULL_EXPERTS = 896


def load_sweep(data_dir: Path, label: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    paths = [
        p
        for p in data_dir.glob("conc-*.json")
        if p.stem.split("-")[1].isdigit() and "topup" not in p.name
    ]
    for path in sorted(paths, key=lambda p: int(p.stem.split("-")[1])):
        d = json.loads(path.read_text())
        rows.append(
            {
                "run": label,
                "concurrency": d["max_concurrency"],
                "num_prompts": d["num_prompts"],
                "duration_s": d["duration"],
                "completed": d["completed"],
                "failed": d["failed"],
                "request_throughput": d["request_throughput"],
                "input_throughput": d["input_throughput"],
                "output_throughput": d["output_throughput"],
                "total_token_throughput": d["total_token_throughput"],
                "mean_ttft_ms": d["mean_ttft_ms"],
                "p90_ttft_ms": d["p90_ttft_ms"],
                "p99_ttft_ms": d["p99_ttft_ms"],
                "mean_tpot_ms": d["mean_tpot_ms"],
                "p90_tpot_ms": d["p90_tpot_ms"],
                "p99_tpot_ms": d["p99_tpot_ms"],
                "mean_itl_ms": d["mean_itl_ms"],
                "mean_e2el_ms": d["mean_e2el_ms"],
                "p90_e2el_ms": d["p90_e2el_ms"],
                "p99_e2el_ms": d["p99_e2el_ms"],
                "max_concurrent_requests": d.get("max_concurrent_requests"),
                "date": d.get("date"),
                "model_id": d.get("model_id"),
            }
        )
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("concurrency").reset_index(drop=True)
    tok1 = df.loc[df["concurrency"] == 1, "output_throughput"].iloc[0]
    df["ideal_output_tok_s"] = tok1 * df["concurrency"]
    df["scaling_efficiency"] = df["output_throughput"] / df["ideal_output_tok_s"]
    return df


df_real = load_sweep(ROOT / "bench-results" / "conc-sweep-real-1000-1000", "real weights")
df_full = load_sweep(ROOT / "bench-results" / "conc-sweep-full-1000-1000", "full dummy (93L)")
df_shallow = load_sweep(ROOT / "bench-results" / "conc-sweep-1000-1000", "shallow dummy (12L)")
df = df_real
base = df.loc[df["concurrency"] == 1].iloc[0]
seed_path = ROOT / "bench-results" / "conc-sweep-real-1000-1000" / "seed.txt"
SWEEP_SEED = seed_path.read_text().strip() if seed_path.exists() else "n/a"

rd = pd.concat([df_real, df_full], ignore_index=True)
shared_rd = sorted(set(df_real["concurrency"]) & set(df_full["concurrency"]))
rd_rows = []
for c in shared_rd:
    r = df_real.loc[df_real["concurrency"] == c].iloc[0]
    f = df_full.loc[df_full["concurrency"] == c].iloc[0]
    rd_rows.append(
        {
            "concurrency": c,
            "real_tok_s": r["output_throughput"],
            "dummy_tok_s": f["output_throughput"],
            "tok_ratio": r["output_throughput"] / f["output_throughput"],
            "real_tpot": r["mean_tpot_ms"],
            "dummy_tpot": f["mean_tpot_ms"],
            "tpot_ratio": r["mean_tpot_ms"] / f["mean_tpot_ms"],
            "real_ttft": r["mean_ttft_ms"],
            "dummy_ttft": f["mean_ttft_ms"],
            "real_e2el_s": r["mean_e2el_ms"] / 1000,
            "dummy_e2el_s": f["mean_e2el_ms"] / 1000,
            "real_eff": r["scaling_efficiency"],
            "dummy_eff": f["scaling_efficiency"],
        }
    )
rd_cmp = pd.DataFrame(rd_rows)
tok_ratio_c1_rd = rd_cmp.loc[rd_cmp["concurrency"] == 1, "tok_ratio"].iloc[0]

both_sf = pd.concat([df_shallow, df_full], ignore_index=True)
shared_sf = sorted(set(df_shallow["concurrency"]) & set(df_full["concurrency"]))
sf_rows = []
for c in shared_sf:
    s = df_shallow.loc[df_shallow["concurrency"] == c].iloc[0]
    f = df_full.loc[df_full["concurrency"] == c].iloc[0]
    sf_rows.append(
        {
            "concurrency": c,
            "shallow_tok_s": s["output_throughput"],
            "full_tok_s": f["output_throughput"],
            "tok_ratio": f["output_throughput"] / s["output_throughput"],
            "shallow_tpot": s["mean_tpot_ms"],
            "full_tpot": f["mean_tpot_ms"],
            "tpot_ratio": f["mean_tpot_ms"] / s["mean_tpot_ms"],
            "shallow_eff": s["scaling_efficiency"],
            "full_eff": f["scaling_efficiency"],
        }
    )
sf_cmp = pd.DataFrame(sf_rows)
layer_ratio_sf = SHALLOW_LAYERS / FULL_LAYERS
layer_ratio_fs = FULL_LAYERS / SHALLOW_LAYERS
tok_ratio_c1_sf = sf_cmp.loc[sf_cmp["concurrency"] == 1, "tok_ratio"].iloc[0]
tpot_ratio_c1_sf = sf_cmp.loc[sf_cmp["concurrency"] == 1, "tpot_ratio"].iloc[0]
```

# Overview

Three `vllm bench serve` concurrency sweeps on fozzie (2×8 H200, TP=16, FLASHMLA / marlin):

1. **Real weights** (primary) — `/models/Kimi-K3` MXFP4 checkpoint, C ∈ {1…256}, seed `{python} SWEEP_SEED`
2. **Full HF dummy** — same 93L / 896-expert architecture, `--load-format dummy`
3. **Shallow dummy** — 12L / 16 experts via `--hf-overrides`, C ∈ {1…32}

All use **1000 input / 1000 output**, `--ignore-eos`, `--request-rate inf`, closed-loop `--max-concurrency`.

::: {.callout-important}
Primary results are the **real-weight** run. Full dummy is a close absolute proxy (~82–100% of real tok/s); shallow dummy remains useful for relative concurrency shape and layer-ratio analysis.
:::

## Deploy comparison

| Knob | Shallow dummy | Full dummy | Real weights |
|------|---------------|------------|--------------|
| Load | dummy | dummy | HF checkpoint (`/models/Kimi-K3`) |
| Layers / experts | 12 / 16 | 93 / 896 | 93 / 896 |
| `--max-num-seqs` | 64 | 128 | 128 |
| `--max-model-len` | 32768 | 8192 | 8192 |
| Data | `conc-sweep-1000-1000/` | `conc-sweep-full-1000-1000/` | `conc-sweep-real-1000-1000/` |

Real-weight bring-up: download onto recipe pods (VAST PVC provisioning failed on fozzie — see `manifests/STORAGE.md`), then `scripts/deploy-recipe.sh`.

## Benchmark method

- Dataset: `random`, 1000/1000, `--ignore-eos`
- Arrival: `--request-rate inf` + `--max-concurrency C`
- ~2 min/tier target (high-C tiers longer as queueing grew)
- Real sweep: unique `--seed` per tier from base `{python} SWEEP_SEED`

```{python}
#| label: method-meta
print(
    f"Real tiers: {list(df_real['concurrency'])}  |  "
    f"C=1 tok/s={base['output_throughput']:.1f}  |  "
    f"wall {df_real['duration_s'].min():.0f}–{df_real['duration_s'].max():.0f}s"
)
```

```{python}
)
show
```

## Throughput (real)

Near-linear through **C=8**, dip at **C=16**, then tok/s plateaus ~405–436 while client concurrency keeps climbing (engine capped at 128 seqs; C=256 oversubscribes).

```{python}
#| label: fig-real-throughput
#| fig-cap: "Real-weight output / request throughput vs concurrency."

fig = make_subplots(specs=[[{"secondary_y": True}]])
fig.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(
        x=df_real["concurrency"],
        y=df_real["output_throughput"],
        mode="lines+markers",
        name="output tok/s",
        hovertemplate="C=%{x}<br>out=%{y:.1f}<extra></extra>",
    ),
    secondary_y=False,
)
fig.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(
        x=df_real["concurrency"],
        y=df_real["ideal_output_tok_s"],
        mode="lines",
        name="ideal (C × tok/s @1)",
        line=dict(dash="dash"),
        hovertemplate="C=%{x}<br>ideal=%{y:.1f}<extra></extra>",
    ),
    secondary_y=False,
)
fig.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(
        x=df_real["concurrency"],
        y=df_real["request_throughput"],
        mode="lines+markers",
        name="req/s",
        hovertemplate="C=%{x}<br>req/s=%{y:.3f}<extra></extra>",
    ),
    secondary_y=True,
)
fig.update_xaxes(title_text="max concurrency", type="log", dtick=1)
fig.update_yaxes(title_text="token throughput (tok/s)", secondary_y=False)
fig.update_yaxes(title_text="request throughput (req/s)", secondary_y=True)
fig.update_layout(legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.02), margin=dict(t=40))
fig.show()
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-real-efficiency
#| fig-cap: "Real-weight scaling efficiency vs C·tok₁."

fig = px.bar(
    df_real,
    x="concurrency",
    y="scaling_efficiency",
    text=df_real["scaling_efficiency"].map(lambda v: f"{100*v:.0f}%"),
    labels={"concurrency": "max concurrency", "scaling_efficiency": "efficiency vs C·tok₁"},
)
fig.update_traces(textposition="outside")
fig.update_xaxes(type="log", dtick=1)
fig.update_yaxes(range=[0, 1.15], tickformat=".0%")
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(t=30))
fig.show()
```

## Latency (real)

TPOT ~25–31 ms through C=8, jumps at C=16 (~75 ms), then settles ~53–57 ms. TTFT/E2EL explode above C=32 as the queue builds against `--max-num-seqs 128`.

```{python}
#| label: fig-real-latency
#| fig-cap: "Real-weight mean TTFT, TPOT, and E2EL."

fig = make_subplots(rows=1, cols=3, subplot_titles=("TTFT (ms)", "TPOT (ms)", "E2EL (s)"))
series = [
    ("mean_ttft_ms", "#1f77b4", 1.0, "ms"),
    ("mean_tpot_ms", "#ff7f0e", 1.0, "ms"),
    ("mean_e2el_ms", "#2ca02c", 0.001, "s"),
]
for i, (col, color, scale, unit) in enumerate(series, start=1):
    y = df_real[col] * scale
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=df_real["concurrency"],
            y=y,
            mode="lines+markers",
            line=dict(color=color),
            hovertemplate=f"C=%{{x}}<br>%{{y:.2f}} {unit}<extra></extra>",
            showlegend=False,
        ),
        row=1,
        col=i,
    )
    fig.update_xaxes(type="log", dtick=1, title_text="C", row=1, col=i)
fig.update_yaxes(type="log", row=1, col=1)
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(t=40))
fig.show()
```

```{python}
#| label: findings-real
#| output: asis
c8 = df_real.loc[df_real["concurrency"] == 8].iloc[0]
c16 = df_real.loc[df_real["concurrency"] == 16].iloc[0]
c32 = df_real.loc[df_real["concurrency"] == 32].iloc[0]
c256 = df_real.loc[df_real["concurrency"] == 256].iloc[0]
print(f"""
- **C=1→8:** near-linear ({base['output_throughput']:.0f} → {c8['output_throughput']:.0f} tok/s), TPOT ~25–31 ms, efficiency ~{100*c8['scaling_efficiency']:.0f}%.
- **C=16:** cliff — tok/s drops to {c16['output_throughput']:.0f}, TPOT jumps to {c16['mean_tpot_ms']:.1f} ms, E2EL ~{c16['mean_e2el_ms']/1000:.0f} s.
- **C=32+:** tok/s recovers then plateaus (~{c32['output_throughput']:.0f}–{c256['output_throughput']:.0f}); peak {c256['output_throughput']:.0f} tok/s at C=256. TTFT/E2EL grow with queueing (C=256 mean E2EL ~{c256['mean_e2el_ms']/1000:.0f} s).
""")
```

# Real vs full dummy

Dummy full-architecture is a strong absolute proxy for real MXFP4 serve on this path.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-real-dummy
#| tbl-cap: "Real vs full dummy on shared concurrency tiers."

show = rd_cmp.copy()
for col in ["real_tok_s", "dummy_tok_s", "real_tpot", "dummy_tpot", "real_e2el_s", "dummy_e2el_s"]:
    show[col] = show[col].round(1 if "tok" in col or "e2el" in col else 2)
show["tok_ratio"] = show["tok_ratio"].round(3)
show["tpot_ratio"] = show["tpot_ratio"].round(3)
show["real_eff"] = (show["real_eff"] * 100).round(1)
show["dummy_eff"] = (show["dummy_eff"] * 100).round(1)
show = show[
    [
        "concurrency",
        "real_tok_s",
        "dummy_tok_s",
        "tok_ratio",
        "real_tpot",
        "dummy_tpot",
        "tpot_ratio",
        "real_e2el_s",
        "dummy_e2el_s",
        "real_eff",
        "dummy_eff",
    ]
].rename(
    columns={
        "concurrency": "C",
        "real_tok_s": "real tok/s",
        "dummy_tok_s": "dummy tok/s",
        "tok_ratio": "real/dummy",
        "real_tpot": "real TPOT",
        "dummy_tpot": "dummy TPOT",
        "tpot_ratio": "TPOT real/dummy",
        "real_e2el_s": "real E2EL s",
        "dummy_e2el_s": "dummy E2EL s",
        "real_eff": "real scale%",
        "dummy_eff": "dummy scale%",
    }
)
show
```

# Appendix: shallow vs full dummy (layer ratio)

Earlier finding: decode cost tracks **layer depth**, not expert count.

```{python}
#| label: layer-math
#| output: asis
print(f"""
| Quantity | Value |
|----------|------:|
| Layer ratio (shallow/full) | **{layer_ratio_sf:.4f}** |
| Observed tok/s ratio @C=1 (full/shallow) | **{tok_ratio_c1_sf:.4f}** |
| tok ratio ÷ layer ratio | **{tok_ratio_c1_sf/layer_ratio_sf:.3f}** |
| Observed TPOT ratio @C=1 (full/shallow) | **{tpot_ratio_c1_sf:.2f}×** |
| Expert count change | {SHALLOW_EXPERTS} → {FULL_EXPERTS} (**{FULL_EXPERTS/SHALLOW_EXPERTS:.0f}×**) |
""")
```
